# Security reporting

Review [the threat model](../docs/SECURITY.md). Do not post tokens, private command
output, or an exploitable vulnerability in a public issue.

If the repository's Security tab offers **Report a vulnerability**, use that
private reporting flow. Its availability is controlled on GitHub and is not
asserted by this file. Otherwise, contact [the repository owner](https://github.com/mithudso)
through an available profile contact method to arrange a suitable reporting channel.

Include the affected version, a minimal sanitized reproduction, impact, and a
suggested fix if known. No response-time SLA or supported-version maintenance
window is established. Use the newest release when reproducing, and avoid testing
against repositories or accounts you are not authorized to access.
